notes: `אִיּוֹב` written once and realized twice, as the object *Job* and the resuming *he* of the possessive relative clause, is a rule 25 discontinuous unit headed on the first occurrence; the alternative marks one of the two `added`.
The possessive `לְ` of the verbless relative carries the *had* (rule 43), `אֲשֶׁר` takes the second *as*, and `כֹּל` takes the comparative quantity *as much*.
*before* is `added`: no morpheme in the clause answers to it.
Variant WLC.JOB.42.10.v002 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; s005 is aligned as ordinary source text.
